title: I asked Fable 5.2 for a better game trailer. It re-filmed my game and recut the whole thing in about an hour
author: shurido
selftext:
I'm a solo dev working on Mineral Zone, a factory builder mixed with tower defence. My Steam trailer was okay but looked homemade, so I asked Claude Code (Fable 5.2) to make a better, more professional version with the same music.

It did the whole job on its own:

* watched the old trailer and worked out what was weak
* started the game and recorded all the scenes again
* picked the best moments and cut them to the beat
* designed new titles and an end card

It took about an hour and I gave it two short prompts in total.

The footage is all in-game, the edit is the AI's.

I really love the "Shields up" scene. Epic! :)

The previous trailer can be seen here: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/4592680/Mineral\_Zone/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4592680/Mineral_Zone/)

I think ill replace this soon with this new version. Or maybe ill do another iteration first. What do you think?

**Edit: how it was made (as asked by the mods)**

The game (Godot 4, C#) has a small "trailer director" inside the project: a scene that loads a real save, hides the HUD, flies scripted cameras, steers the pilot and writes frames plus game audio at a fixed frame rate. It runs in an isolated user folder, so my real saves are never touched. I built that tool with Claude Code in earlier sessions. Without it an agent could not film anything.

I develop the game with Claude Code as well. What helps most is giving the agent ways to check its own work: a project instructions file, scripted tests it can run headless, and tools that render a screen or a building to an image so it can look at the result.
